name: SDN HTTP Route
description: The HTTP edge's parser (typed contracts 1.0): one $HTQ HttpRequest envelope (the SDK's WASM-served HTTP request) in, exactly ONE typed routing decision out. Query/data routes are decided as an SDS $QRP (Query Page) KIND Request, the other routes as an SDS $APR (API Request); refusals are decisions too ($QRP KIND Error with ERROR_CODE, or $APR STATUS + ERROR_CODE + ERROR_MESSAGE), answered by foundation/http-respond. A method that can decide more than one way answers on more than one port, so every port carries exactly one type. Methods: route (data retrieval: /<code>/bulk -> bulk, /query -> query, else refusal), discover (peers_list, peer_get, pnm_history, latest_dataset, standards), route_public_query (POST -> query, GET/HEAD -> surface), route_node_status (status), route_node_activity (activity + limit). All HTTP semantics live here: path routing, query-string parsing (epoch as RFC3339 or unix seconds -> PROFILE_EPOCH_MS; profile|mode -> TIME_PROFILE; limit; source), If-None-Match (QRP ETAG / APR IF_NONE_MATCH), representation (?format=json or an Accept header naming application/json -> Json; ?format=flatbuffer or an Accept naming FlatBuffers -> FlatBuffer; else Default), and the client's request body (JSON or raw SQL) parsed into typed fields (SQL, PARAMETERS as QRPValue). JSON appears only as the client's own request representation; nothing between modules is JSON. Pure compute: no capabilities, no hostcalls.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Canonical WASM-served HTTP request envelope ($HTQ, module-sdk schemas/HttpRequestAbi.fbs): METHOD, PATH (no query string), QUERY (raw, URL-encoded), HEADERS (sorted, lower-cased names), BODY, REMOTE.

inputPorts.description: One $HTQ HttpRequest envelope as delivered verbatim by the host pipe.

acceptedTypeSets.description: $QRP KIND Request for "/<code>/bulk" (ANY SDS standard code; the path's shape is parsed by src/bulk_route.h): SCHEMA_NAME the code ("OMM"), FILE_IDENTIFIER "$<CODE>", SOURCE_NAME (?source), TIME_PROFILE (?profile, alias ?mode: nearest|as_of|forward|latest|all; absent = Unspecified: the serving node's configured default applies; all = every record in the window), PROFILE_EPOCH_MS (?epoch RFC3339 or unix seconds; 0 = now), LIMIT (?limit, positive integer; 0 = the default), REPRESENTATION, ETAG = If-None-Match verbatim.

outputPorts.description: Exactly one of bulk / query / refusal carries a frame per request.

acceptedTypeSets.description: $QRP KIND Request for "/query": SQL (from a JSON body {"sql","params"} or raw SQL text), PARAMETERS typed QRPValue (tagged {"t":"i64|f64|str|bool|null|bytes","v"} or bare JSON scalars; bytes base64), REPRESENTATION, ETAG.

outputPorts.description: Exactly one of bulk / query / refusal carries a frame per request.

acceptedTypeSets.description: $QRP KIND Error (STATUS Error): ERROR_CODE + MESSAGE + HTTP_STATUS, with the request's REPRESENTATION and ETAG (If-None-Match) so the responder renders it. Codes: no-route 404, method-not-allowed 405, not-acceptable 406, and 400 for missing-sql, invalid-body, invalid-params, invalid-sort, invalid-profile, invalid-epoch.

outputPorts.description: The request refused; wire it straight to foundation/http-respond respond_query "decision".

methods.description: Parses the $HTQ request for the data-retrieval surface (path suffix routing, query-string parameters, representation, If-None-Match, the POST /query body) into ONE typed decision: a $QRP Request on "bulk" or "query", or a $QRP Error on "refusal". A bulk read asking for JSON of a standard other than $OMM is refused (not-acceptable): the responder renders JSON for $OMM records only. BATCHING: the "request" port is single-stream BY CONTRACT and that is ENFORCED IN CODE: the compiled flow runtime drains a node's whole queue port-blind (maxStreams/maxBatch/drainPolicy are declarative only), so a second request frame in one invocation is refused with error code "batched-input-frames" naming the port and the count rather than answered from whichever frame the queue held first (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames).

acceptedTypeSets.description: $APR: METHOD, PATH, ROUTE peers_list | peer_get (PARAMETERS peerId) | pnm_history (peerId, limit clamped [1,100], default 1) | latest_dataset (peerId, standard) | standards; IF_NONE_MATCH; ACCEPT. A non-GET/HEAD request or an unmatched path is refused: STATUS 404, ERROR_CODE no-route.

methods.description: Parses the $HTQ request for the network-discovery surface into one $APR: .../peers -> peers_list, .../peers/<peerId> -> peer_get, .../peers/<peerId>/pnm -> pnm_history (?limit clamped in-wasm to [1,100], default 1 = the newest publication), .../peers/<peerId>/<standard>/latest -> latest_dataset, .../standards -> standards (suffix-matched, one trailing slash tolerated, segments percent-decoded); anything else, or a non-GET/HEAD method, is the 404 refusal. BATCHING: the "request" port is single-stream BY CONTRACT and that is ENFORCED IN CODE: the compiled flow runtime drains a node's whole queue port-blind (maxStreams/maxBatch/drainPolicy are declarative only), so a second request frame in one invocation is refused with error code "batched-input-frames" naming the port and the count rather than answered from whichever frame the queue held first (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames).

methods.description: Parses a public /api/v1/query request (gateway loop G.5) into one typed decision: POST -> "query" (the body is the client's JSON {sql, params, format, limit, sort, profile, epoch, source} or raw SQL text), GET/HEAD -> "surface", any other method -> "refusal" (405 method-not-allowed); a POST with neither SQL nor a profile is refused 400 missing-sql. Pure parsing: sort/limit/profile compose in hostcap/flatsql-query sandbox_query and the engine enforces the sandbox. BATCHING: the "request" port is single-stream BY CONTRACT and that is ENFORCED IN CODE: the compiled flow runtime drains a node's whole queue port-blind (maxStreams/maxBatch/drainPolicy are declarative only), so a second request frame in one invocation is refused with error code "batched-input-frames" naming the port and the count rather than answered from whichever frame the queue held first (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames).

$APR: ROUTE status for GET/HEAD (ACCEPT from ?format / Accept), or STATUS 405 ERROR_CODE method-not-allowed for any other method. PATH is not inspected: the mount carries one resource.

outputPorts.description: Exactly one $APR per request (M1 node-status flow).

methods.description: Parses a GET /api/v1/node/status request into one $APR: GET/HEAD -> route status (hostcap/node-status answers it with an $NHS), anything else -> STATUS 405. No conditional GET: the snapshot changes on every call. $APR: ROUTE activity with PARAMETERS limit (?limit clamped in-wasm to [1,256], default 50; a value that is not a whole integer falls back to 50) for GET/HEAD, or STATUS 405 ERROR_CODE method-not-allowed for any other method.

methods.description: Parses a GET /api/v1/node/activity request into one $APR: GET/HEAD -> route activity + the clamped limit (hostcap/node-activity forwards it to node_activity_read.activity and answers with an $NEV), anything else -> STATUS 405. sequentialJustification.detail: Each method parses one $HTQ request into exactly one typed routing decision on the calling thread; no thread is created.
